title: Sign your pending Signer documents from a Claude Code skill

title: Receive webhooks with a minimal HTTP endpoint
title_pt: Receber webhooks com um endpoint HTTP mínimo
description: Listens on `http://localhost:8080/webhook` (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_PORT` changes the port) with `System.Net.HttpListener`. It answers 401 unless the `Authorization` header matches the token registered with the webhook (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`), answers 200 before processing the event, ignores an event it already received (keyed on `type`, document `id` and `flowActionId`), and before acting on `DocumentConcluded` reads the document back and checks that its `status` is `Concluded`. Keeps the event keys in memory, then calls `CheckDocumentStatusScenario.HandleWebhook`. `HttpListener` accepts only the `localhost` Host header, so a tunnel must rewrite it (ngrok `--host-header=rewrite`).

title: Receive webhooks with a minimal HTTP endpoint
title_pt: Receber webhooks com um endpoint HTTP mínimo
description: Listens on `http://localhost:8080/webhook` (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_PORT` changes the port) with the JDK's `com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer`. It answers 401 unless the `Authorization` header matches the token registered with the webhook (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`), answers 200 before processing the event, ignores an event it already received (keyed on `type`, document `id` and `flowActionId`), and before acting on `DocumentConcluded` reads the document back and checks that its `status` is `Concluded`. Keeps the event keys in memory and processes events on a separate thread, then calls `CheckDocumentStatusScenario.HandleWebhook`.

title: Receive webhooks with a minimal HTTP endpoint
title_pt: Receber webhooks com um endpoint HTTP mínimo
description: Listens on `http://localhost:8080/webhook` (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_PORT` changes the port) with Node's `http` module. It answers 401 unless the `Authorization` header matches the token registered with the webhook (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`), answers 200 before processing the event, ignores an event it already received (keyed on `type`, document `id` and `flowActionId`), and before acting on `DocumentConcluded` reads the document back and checks that its `status` is `Concluded`. Keeps the event keys in memory, then calls `handleWebhook` from `checkDocumentStatusScenario.ts`.

title: Receive webhooks with a minimal HTTP endpoint
title_pt: Receber webhooks com um endpoint HTTP mínimo
description: Answers on `http://localhost:8080/webhook` under PHP's built-in web server, with `webhook.php` as the router script. It answers 401 unless the `Authorization` header matches the token registered with the webhook (`SIGNER_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`), answers 200 before processing the event, ignores an event it already received (keyed on `type`, document `id` and `flowActionId`), and before acting on `DocumentConcluded` reads the document back and checks that its `status` is `Concluded`. PHP keeps nothing in memory between requests, so each event key is recorded as a file in the temp folder. Then it passes the body to `CheckDocumentStatusScenario::HandleWebhook`.

title: Download a document's versions
title_pt: Baixar as versões de um documento
description: Gets a download ticket (a temporary URL), saves `Original` and fetches its bytes with `GetDocumentBytesAsync`, then saves the signed file (`Signatures`) and the `PrinterFriendlyVersion`, as `downloaded-*.pdf` in the working folder. Both need at least one signature (until then the API answers 422 `DocumentHasNoSignatures`), so it reads `HasSignature` and `Status` first and skips `Signatures` for canceled, refused and expired documents. Set `SignedDocumentId` to a signed document's id; while it is null, the sample creates an unsigned document and saves only `Original`.

title: Download a document's versions
title_pt: Baixar as versões de um documento
description: Gets a download ticket (a temporary URL), saves `Original` and fetches its bytes with `getDocumentBytes`, then saves the signed file (`Signatures`) and the `PrinterFriendlyVersion`, as `downloaded-*.pdf` in `java/console`. Both need at least one signature (until then the API answers 422 `DocumentHasNoSignatures`, which `getDocumentContent` reports as a `RestUnreachableException` without the code), so it reads `isHasSignature()` and `getStatus()` first and skips `Signatures` for canceled, refused and expired documents. Set `SIGNED_DOCUMENT_ID` to a signed document's id; while it is null, the sample creates an unsigned document and saves only `Original`.

title: Download a document's versions
title_pt: Baixar as versões de um documento
description: Gets a download ticket (a temporary URL), saves `Original` and fetches its bytes from `GET /api/documents/{id}/content-b64`, then saves the signed file (`Signatures`) and the `PrinterFriendlyVersion`, as `nodejs/samples/downloaded-*.pdf`. It passes `responseType: 'arraybuffer'` to `apiDocumentsIdContentGet` so axios keeps the bytes unchanged. Both need at least one signature (until then the API answers 422 `DocumentHasNoSignatures`), so it reads `hasSignature` and `status` first and skips `Signatures` for canceled, refused and expired documents. Set `signedDocumentId` to a signed document's id; while it is null, the sample creates an unsigned document and saves only `Original`.

title: Download a document's versions
title_pt: Baixar as versões de um documento
description: Gets a download ticket (a temporary URL), saves `Original` and its bytes from `GET /api/documents/{id}/content-b64`, then saves the signed file (`Signatures`) and the `PrinterFriendlyVersion`, as `php/resources/downloaded-*.pdf`. Both need at least one signature (until then the API answers 422 `DocumentHasNoSignatures`, and `getDocumentContent` returns that error JSON instead of throwing), so it reads `getHasSignature()` and `getStatus()` first and skips `Signatures` for canceled, refused and expired documents. Set `SIGNED_DOCUMENT_ID` to a signed document's id; while it is null, the sample creates an unsigned document and saves only `Original`.
